entry.title: New: dsh-github-picker
entry.summary: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh CLI, and insert the reference as a URL or @owner/repo#number mention. Exact install spec: github:bitxeno/dsh-github-picker. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
